0.long_answer: Trichomonas vaginalis is a sexually transmitted protozoan parasite that is well-known for causing both vaginitis and cervicitis. This infection, commonly referred to as trichomoniasis, affects the human vagina and cervix, leading to inflammation, irritation, and sometimes discharge. Trichomoniasis is one of the most common non-viral sexually transmitted infections and may result in additional complications if not properly treated.
